Clear the stencil buffer entry for these pixels if the pixel passes the depth test, correcting erroneous stencil entries caused by back-face-only rendering [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that the stencil buffer entry should be cleared for pixels that pass the depth test when rendering front faces, to correct erroneous stencil entries from back-face-only rendering. Source [S1] explicitly states: 'The front faces are thus rendered into those pixels where the stencil buffer is set and the stencil buffer is cleared where a pixel also passes the depth test.' It further explains this is done to correct improper stencil settings caused by rendering only back faces. Thus, every fact in the claim is present in the evidence.

- **Stencil Buffer:** A per-pixel integer buffer that tracks which pixels are covered by the clipping cross-section [S1, unofficial].

The evidence also mentions 'stencil bits' and 'stencil buffer entries,' confirming it is an integer-based per-pixel buffer. All facts in the claim are present and supported by the source text.
